opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Fast expansion with early combat units and factory production
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of second production observed (97.1%) compared to baseline (52.8%), indicating early production structures.
First combat unit observed rate is 96.4% vs baseline 72.6%, suggesting early military presence.
Factory presence is 55.0% vs baseline 28.9%, showing a significant factory build.
The medoid key sequence shows early barracks, gas, orbital command, factory, and bio combat unit, consistent with a bio-focused expand.
